items_flat.title_en: Mistral launches Large 4 preview, nicknamed Le Chonk
items_flat.title_zh: Mistral 推出 Large 4 公開預覽，暱稱 Le Chonk
items_flat.summary_en: Mistral launched a public preview of Mistral Large 4, officially nicknamed le Chonk, a natively multimodal mixture-of-experts model it describes as about 1 trillion parameters with 49 billion active. The model card lists 1.05 trillion total and 52 billion active plus a 1.6 billion vision encoder, a 1 million-token context, and preview pricing of $1.36 per million input tokens and $4.18 output. It was trained from scratch on 3,800 NVIDIA Grace Blackwell GPUs in Mistral’s European datacenters; the preview API is on Mistral Studio, and weights are planned by the end of October after partner red-teaming.
items_flat.summary_zh: Mistral 公開預覽 Mistral Large 4，正式暱稱 le Chonk。公告稱其為原生多模態混合專家模型，約 1 兆參數、490 億啟動；模型卡則列 1.05 兆總參數、520 億啟動，另有 16 億視覺編碼器、100 萬 token 上下文，預覽價為每百萬輸入 1.36 美元、輸出 4.18 美元。模型在歐洲自有資料中心的 3,800 顆 NVIDIA Grace Blackwell GPU 上從零訓練，預覽 API 已上 Mistral Studio，權重預計 10 月底、夥伴紅隊測試後釋出。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is the clearest European open-weight bid at frontier scale in the window, but the weights are not public yet and headline cyber scores are Mistral’s own. The practical shift is a sovereign preview endpoint now, with auditability deferred until the late-October weight drop.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是窗口內最明確的歐洲開源權重前沿嘗試，但權重尚未公開，資安分數也是 Mistral 自報。實質變化是現在有主權預覽端點，可審計性要等到月底權重釋出。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re launching a public preview of Mistral Large 4. Unofficially ML4, very officially: le Chonk. Weights drop end of this month.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們推出 Mistral Large 4 公開預覽。非正式稱 ML4，正式暱稱是 le Chonk。權重將於本月底釋出。

items_flat.title_en: Google DeepMind releases EmbeddingGemma 2 under Apache 2.0
items_flat.title_zh: Google DeepMind 以 Apache 2.0 釋出 EmbeddingGemma 2
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind launched EmbeddingGemma 2, a 740-million-parameter open embedding model built on Gemma 4 that maps text, code, images, audio, and video into one shared space, with an 8,192-token context and Matryoshka truncation. Google says code retrieval on MTEB rose from 68.76 to 78.68 and that the prior EmbeddingGemma line has more than 20 million downloads. Weights are on Hugging Face and Kaggle under Apache 2.0.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 推出 EmbeddingGemma 2，以 Gemma 4 為基礎的 7.4 億參數開放嵌入模型，把文字、程式碼、影像、音訊與影片映到同一空間，上下文 8,192 token，並支援 Matryoshka 截斷。Google 稱 MTEB 程式碼檢索從 68.76 升至 78.68，前代下載超過 2,000 萬次。權重已以 Apache 2.0 放上 Hugging Face 與 Kaggle。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a productized open embedding release, not a new frontier chatbot. The practical change is private cross-modal search on phones and laptops; whether it beats larger specialist embedders outside Google’s own tables is still open.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是產品化的開放嵌入模型，不是新的前沿聊天模型。實質改變是手機與筆電上的私密跨模態搜尋；它是否在 Google 自測表之外勝過更大的專用嵌入模型，仍待第三方驗證。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re launching EmbeddingGemma 2, expanding beyond text to unify code, images, video, and audio in a shared embedding space.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們推出 EmbeddingGemma 2，從文字擴展到把程式碼、影像、影片與音訊統一到同一個嵌入空間。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic expands Cyber Verification Program into three tiers
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 把網路安全驗證計畫擴成三級
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic launched an expanded Cyber Verification Program that merges Project Glasswing and the earlier CVP, giving qualifying security teams reduced blocking classifiers on Claude Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, Mythos 5.1, and future models. Defense Access covers incident response and malware analysis; higher tiers add tighter vetting, with Specialized Access limited to critical-infrastructure testers cleared with the U.S. government. Anthropic says Glasswing partners uncovered at least 129,000 verified vulnerabilities between April and July 2026.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 推出擴充版網路安全驗證計畫，合併 Project Glasswing 與舊版 CVP，讓合格安全團隊在 Claude Opus 5.5、Sonnet 5.5、Mythos 5.1 及後續模型上減少阻擋分類器。Defense Access 涵蓋事件應變與惡意程式分析；更高層級審核更嚴，Specialized Access 僅限與美國政府核可的關鍵基礎設施測試者。Anthropic 稱 Glasswing 夥伴在 2026 年 4 至 7 月找出至少 12.9 萬個已驗證漏洞。
items_flat.analysis_en: The shift is from a small critical-software pilot to a tiered defender program, while general models stay tightly blocked on cyber work. The vulnerability counts are partner-survey figures, not an independent audit of exploit quality.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 變化是從小型關鍵軟體試點變成分級防禦者計畫，一般模型的資安工作仍受嚴格阻擋。漏洞數來自夥伴調查，並非對利用品質的獨立稽核。
items_flat.quote: We’re launching a new, expanded version of our Cyber Verification Program (CVP), which makes advanced cyber capabilities and reduced blocking classifiers available to qualifying security professionals.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們推出擴充版網路安全驗證計畫（CVP），讓合格的安全專業人員取得進階資安能力，並降低阻擋分類器。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI publishes math results from an internal frontier model
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 公布內部前沿模型的數學成果
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI said it is releasing a broad set of new mathematical results produced by an internal frontier model, after consulting the Institute for Advanced Study’s Advisory Group on Mathematics and AI. Results go to a GitHub repository with revision and citation protocols, Lean formalizations, 10 reasoning summaries, compute estimates in ChatGPT Pro usage, and attempt statistics. OpenAI says the average result used about three hours of Pro thinking equivalent, and that it is working to release the model responsibly rather than shipping it now.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 表示，在諮詢普林斯頓高等研究院數學與人工智慧諮詢小組後，公布內部前沿模型產出的一批新數學成果。成果放在 GitHub，附論文修訂與引用規範、Lean 形式化證明、10 則推理摘要、以 ChatGPT Pro 用量估算的算力，以及嘗試次數統計。OpenAI 稱平均每項成果約等同三小時 Pro 思考，並表示正著手負責任地釋出該模型，而非現在上線。
items_flat.analysis_en: The notable change is the disclosure protocol—GitHub, Lean, and compute notes—not a public model. Whether the results hold depends on community formalization; OpenAI has not named or released the system that produced them.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 值得注意的是揭露方式：GitHub、Lean 與算力說明，而不是公開模型。成果是否成立取決於社群形式化；OpenAI 尚未命名或釋出產出這些結果的系統。
items_flat.quote: We’re releasing a broad range of new mathematical results produced by an internal frontier model.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們正在發布由內部前沿模型產出的一系列新數學成果。

items_flat.title_en: Google ships Nano Banana 2.1 image model update
items_flat.title_zh: Google 推出 Nano Banana 2.1 圖像模型更新
items_flat.summary_en: Google’s Gemini API docs list Gemini Nano Banana 2.1 (`gemini-nano-banana-2.1`) as the latest high-efficiency image generation and editing model, an update to Nano Banana 2. Google cites better realism at 1K, 2K, and 4K, fixed tiling on extreme aspect ratios, stronger text and infographic layout, fusion of up to 14 reference images, search grounding, and configurable thinking. Reporting says it is rolling out to the Gemini app, AI Mode, AI Studio, Flow, and related Google products.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google Gemini API 文件列出 Gemini Nano Banana 2.1（`gemini-nano-banana-2.1`），作為 Nano Banana 2 的高效圖像生成與編輯更新。Google 稱 1K、2K、4K 更寫實，極端長寬比的拼接瑕疵已修，文字與資訊圖排版更準，最多融合 14 張參考圖，並支援搜尋落地與可調思考等級。報導稱它正推向 Gemini app、AI Mode、AI Studio、Flow 等產品。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a versioned image-model update, not a new frontier LLM. The user-facing change is consistency and wide-frame quality at Flash-class cost; independent quality comparisons were not in the docs page.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是圖像模型的版本更新，不是新的前沿語言模型。使用者端的變化是 Flash 級成本下的一致性與寬幅畫質；文件頁沒有獨立品質對照。
items_flat.quote: Gemini Nano Banana 2.1 is the latest high-efficiency image generation and conversational editing model.
items_flat.quote_zh: Gemini Nano Banana 2.1 是最新的高效圖像生成與對話式編輯模型。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI trains GPT-6 Astra on Ironclad contracting tasks
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 以 Ironclad 合約任務訓練 GPT-6 Astra
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI published a research collaboration with Ironclad to turn contracting workflows into agent training and evaluation tasks, including agreement setup, approvals, and reusable legal terms. It says GPT-6 Astra is the first frontier model trained on those tasks and scored 32% higher than GPT-5.6 Sol on an internal research evaluation while using 48% less estimated time per attempt. OpenAI said it plans similar collaborations with a small number of other software companies.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 公布與 Ironclad 的研究合作，把合約流程做成代理訓練與評測任務，包括設定協議、核准與可重用法律條款。OpenAI 稱 GPT-6 Astra 是第一個在這些任務上訓練的前沿模型，內部研究評測平均分數比 GPT-5.6 Sol 高 32%，每次嘗試估計時間少 48%。OpenAI 表示打算與少數其他軟體公司做類似合作。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a domain-data partnership, not a new model launch. The 32% and 48% figures are OpenAI’s internal eval, so they show direction on a narrow legal workflow rather than a general agent benchmark.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是領域資料合作，不是新模型發布。32% 與 48% 是 OpenAI 內部評測，說明的是狹窄法律流程上的方向，不是通用代理基準。
items_flat.quote: GPT-6 Astra is our first frontier model trained on Ironclad tasks. On our research evaluation, its average score was 32% higher than GPT-5.6 Sol’s, while estimated time per attempt was 48% lower.
items_flat.quote_zh: GPT-6 Astra 是我們第一個在 Ironclad 任務上訓練的前沿模型。在研究評測中，平均分數比 GPT-5.6 Sol 高 32%，每次嘗試的估計時間少 48%。

items_flat.title_en: Meta and Sierra publish a Personal Agent Protocol
items_flat.title_zh: Meta 與 Sierra 提出個人代理協定
items_flat.summary_en: Sierra said it and Meta are developing Personal Agent Protocol, an open standard for how personal AI agents authenticate and act with businesses via websites, APIs, or a company-owned agent. Named partners include Genesys, Instinct, Rocket, Shopify, Stripe, and Walmart. The write-up frames consumer consent and merchant controls as the core design, and does not ship a Meta product toggle.
items_flat.summary_zh: Sierra 表示正與 Meta 開發 Personal Agent Protocol，一套開放標準，規範個人 AI 代理如何透過網站、API 或企業自有代理向商家驗證身分並執行操作。具名夥伴包括 Genesys、Instinct、Rocket、Shopify、Stripe 與 Walmart。文章把消費者同意與商家控制當成核心設計，並未推出 Meta 產品開關。
items_flat.analysis_en: The story is a standards bid around agentic commerce, not a Muse feature launch. Adoption depends on whether merchants implement it; the primary post is Sierra’s, with Meta listed as a co-developer rather than the publisher.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是代理商務的標準提案，不是 Muse 功能上線。採用與否取決於商家是否實作；主要貼文來自 Sierra，Meta 被列為共同開發者而非發布方。
items_flat.quote: Today we’re excited to announce Personal Agent Protocol — an open standard Meta and Sierra are developing along with industry partners.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們宣布 Personal Agent Protocol——Meta 與 Sierra 正與產業夥伴共同開發的開放標準。

items_flat.title_en: Google details Earth AI outbreak forecasts with health partners
items_flat.title_zh: Google 說明 Earth AI 與衛生夥伴的疫情預報
items_flat.summary_en: Google Research and Google Health published field results for Google Earth AI, pairing AlphaEarth Foundations, the Population Dynamics Foundation Model, and a prototype Geospatial Reasoning agent with partner health data. With WHO AFRO and other health partners, Google describes agent-assisted targeting during an active outbreak rather than a generally available product.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google Research 與 Google Health 公布 Google Earth AI 的現場結果，把 AlphaEarth Foundations、人口動態基礎模型與原型地理空間推理代理，和夥伴的衛生資料搭配。與 WHO AFRO 等衛生夥伴合作時，Google 描述的是疫情進行中的代理輔助標定，而不是一般可取得的產品。
items_flat.analysis_en: The shift is from maps to agent-assisted targeting in an active outbreak, but the figures come from partner prototypes rather than a generally available product. Lead time and false-alarm rates still need independent replication.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 變化是從地圖走到疫情中的代理輔助標定，但數字來自夥伴原型，不是一般公開產品。前置時間與誤報率仍需獨立複現。
items_flat.quote: We're helping public health leaders overcome reporting lags, forecast disease outbreaks, and deliver care to vulnerable communities around the world by combining local health data with advanced geospatial models.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們協助公衛主管克服通報延遲、預報疾病爆發，並把在地衛生資料與進階地理空間模型結合，把照護送到脆弱社區。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI opens Decisions API beta on GPT-6 Luna
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 以 GPT-6 Luna 開放 Decisions API 測試版
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI released the Decisions API in public beta with gpt-6-luna, aimed at turning text and images into typed answers it says are up to 10x faster than the Responses API. Outputs are predicates, choices with confidence scores, or numeric scores. Pricing listed in the developer forum is $0.10 per million input tokens, with no output-token charge. Docs also show a voice path that calls Decisions while a Live session keeps speaking.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 以 gpt-6-luna 公開測試 Decisions API，把文字與圖像轉成型別化答案，並稱比 Responses API 快最多 10 倍。輸出為謂詞、帶信心分數的選項，或數值分數。開發者論壇列出的價格是每百萬輸入 token 0.10 美元，不計輸出 token。文件另有語音路徑，可在 Live 會話持續說話時呼叫 Decisions。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a routing primitive, not a new model: it productizes constrained classification that developers already approximated with structured outputs. The speed claim is OpenAI’s, and early community checks are too narrow to treat as a general benchmark.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是路由原語，不是新模型：它把開發者原本用結構化輸出近似的約束分類產品化。速度說法來自 OpenAI，早期社群測試範圍太窄，不能當成通用基準。
items_flat.quote: The Decisions API makes decisions up to 10x faster than GPT-6 Luna through the Responses API.
items_flat.quote_zh: Decisions API 做決策的速度，比透過 Responses API 使用 GPT-6 Luna 快最多 10 倍。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI collapses API usage tiers to Build, Launch, and Grow
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 把 API 用量級距收成 Build、Launch、Grow
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI’s API changelog and developer-forum post say paid usage tiers drop from five to three: Build, Launch, and Grow. Organizations move automatically as credit purchases hit tier minimums. Grow, the new top tier, now qualifies at $500 in total API payments, down from $1,000 for the previous highest tier.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI API 更新日誌與開發者論壇表示，付費用量級距從五級收成三級：Build、Launch 與 Grow。組織在累計購買點數達到門檻後自動升級。新的最高級 Grow 現在累計 API 付款 500 美元即可達到，低於先前最高級的 1,000 美元。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a rate-limit and spend-threshold change, not a model release. It lowers the cash needed to reach the old top monthly cap; per-model RPM and TPM still vary by tier.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是速率與消費門檻調整，不是模型發布。它降低達到舊最高月額所需的金額；各模型的每分鐘請求與 token 仍隨級距不同。
items_flat.quote: Five paid usage tiers become three: Build, Launch, and Grow.
items_flat.quote_zh: 五個付費用量級距變成三個：Build、Launch 與 Grow。

items_flat.title_en: Google Flow Music Spaces can export as DAW plugins
items_flat.title_zh: Google Flow Music 的 Space 可匯出成 DAW 外掛
items_flat.summary_en: Google Labs said producers can now export custom Spaces from Google Flow Music as VST3 or AU plugins and run them inside a digital audio workstation. Spaces are instruments or effects described in natural language, without coding. Google positioned the export as a bridge from the Labs experiment into existing studio software.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google Labs 表示，製作人現在可把 Google Flow Music 的自訂 Space 匯出成 VST3 或 AU 外掛，放進數位音訊工作站使用。Space 是用自然語言描述的樂器或效果，不必寫程式。Google 把這次匯出定位成從 Labs 實驗接到現有錄音軟體的橋。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a creator-tool bridge from a Labs experiment into existing studio software, not a model launch. Adoption depends on whether exported plugins hold up in professional sessions.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是從 Labs 實驗接到現有錄音軟體的創作者工具橋，不是模型發布。採用取決於匯出的外掛能否撐住專業工作階段。
items_flat.quote: Producers can now export their custom Spaces as VST3/AU plugins, to run inside their Digital Audio Workstations (DAWs).
items_flat.quote_zh: 製作人現在可以把自訂 Spaces 匯出成 VST3/AU 外掛，在數位音訊工作站裡執行。

Outputs are predicates, choices with confidence scores, or numeric scores. Pricing listed in the developer forum is $0.10 per million input tokens, with no output-token charge. Docs also show a voice path that calls Decisions while a Live session keeps speaking.
openai.summary_zh: OpenAI 以 gpt-6-luna 公開測試 Decisions API，把文字與圖像轉成型別化答案，並稱比 Responses API 快最多 10 倍。輸出為謂詞、帶信心分數的選項，或數值分數。開發者論壇列出的價格是每百萬輸入 token 0.10 美元，不計輸出 token。文件另有語音路徑，可在 Live 會話持續說話時呼叫 Decisions。
openai.analysis_en: This is a routing primitive, not a new model: it productizes constrained classification that developers already approximated with structured outputs. The speed claim is OpenAI’s, and early community checks are too narrow to treat as a general benchmark.
openai.analysis_zh: 這是路由原語，不是新模型：它把開發者原本用結構化輸出近似的約束分類產品化。速度說法來自 OpenAI，早期社群測試範圍太窄，不能當成通用基準。
openai.quote: The Decisions API makes decisions up to 10x faster than GPT-6 Luna through the Responses API.
openai.quote_zh: Decisions API 做決策的速度，比透過 Responses API 使用 GPT-6 Luna 快最多 10 倍。

openai.title_en: OpenAI collapses API usage tiers to Build, Launch, and Grow
openai.title_zh: OpenAI 把 API 用量級距收成 Build、Launch、Grow
openai.summary_en: OpenAI’s API changelog and developer-forum post say paid usage tiers drop from five to three: Build, Launch, and Grow. Organizations move automatically as credit purchases hit tier minimums. Grow, the new top tier, now qualifies at $500 in total API payments, down from $1,000 for the previous highest tier.
openai.summary_zh: OpenAI API 更新日誌與開發者論壇表示，付費用量級距從五級收成三級：Build、Launch 與 Grow。組織在累計購買點數達到門檻後自動升級。新的最高級 Grow 現在累計 API 付款 500 美元即可達到，低於先前最高級的 1,000 美元。
openai.analysis_en: This is a rate-limit and spend-threshold change, not a model release. It lowers the cash needed to reach the old top monthly cap; per-model RPM and TPM still vary by tier.
openai.analysis_zh: 這是速率與消費門檻調整，不是模型發布。它降低達到舊最高月額所需的金額；各模型的每分鐘請求與 token 仍隨級距不同。
openai.quote: Five paid usage tiers become three: Build, Launch, and Grow.
openai.quote_zh: 五個付費用量級距變成三個：Build、Launch 與 Grow。

anthropic.title_en: Anthropic expands Cyber Verification Program into three tiers
anthropic.title_zh: Anthropic 把網路安全驗證計畫擴成三級
anthropic.summary_en: Anthropic launched an expanded Cyber Verification Program that merges Project Glasswing and the earlier CVP, giving qualifying security teams reduced blocking classifiers on Claude Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, Mythos 5.1, and future models. Defense Access covers incident response and malware analysis; higher tiers add tighter vetting, with Specialized Access limited to critical-infrastructure testers cleared with the U.S. government. Anthropic says Glasswing partners uncovered at least 129,000 verified vulnerabilities between April and July 2026.
anthropic.summary_zh: Anthropic 推出擴充版網路安全驗證計畫，合併 Project Glasswing 與舊版 CVP，讓合格安全團隊在 Claude Opus 5.5、Sonnet 5.5、Mythos 5.1 及後續模型上減少阻擋分類器。Defense Access 涵蓋事件應變與惡意程式分析；更高層級審核更嚴，Specialized Access 僅限與美國政府核可的關鍵基礎設施測試者。Anthropic 稱 Glasswing 夥伴在 2026 年 4 至 7 月找出至少 12.9 萬個已驗證漏洞。
anthropic.analysis_en: The shift is from a small critical-software pilot to a tiered defender program, while general models stay tightly blocked on cyber work. The vulnerability counts are partner-survey figures, not an independent audit of exploit quality.
anthropic.analysis_zh: 變化是從小型關鍵軟體試點變成分級防禦者計畫，一般模型的資安工作仍受嚴格阻擋。漏洞數來自夥伴調查，並非對利用品質的獨立稽核。
anthropic.quote: We’re launching a new, expanded version of our Cyber Verification Program (CVP), which makes advanced cyber capabilities and reduced blocking classifiers available to qualifying security professionals.
anthropic.quote_zh: 我們推出擴充版網路安全驗證計畫（CVP），讓合格的安全專業人員取得進階資安能力，並降低阻擋分類器。

google.title_en: Google DeepMind releases EmbeddingGemma 2 under Apache 2.0
google.title_zh: Google DeepMind 以 Apache 2.0 釋出 EmbeddingGemma 2
google.summary_en: Google DeepMind launched EmbeddingGemma 2, a 740-million-parameter open embedding model built on Gemma 4 that maps text, code, images, audio, and video into one shared space, with an 8,192-token context and Matryoshka truncation. Google says code retrieval on MTEB rose from 68.76 to 78.68 and that the prior EmbeddingGemma line has more than 20 million downloads. Weights are on Hugging Face and Kaggle under Apache 2.0.
google.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 推出 EmbeddingGemma 2，以 Gemma 4 為基礎的 7.4 億參數開放嵌入模型，把文字、程式碼、影像、音訊與影片映到同一空間，上下文 8,192 token，並支援 Matryoshka 截斷。Google 稱 MTEB 程式碼檢索從 68.76 升至 78.68，前代下載超過 2,000 萬次。權重已以 Apache 2.0 放上 Hugging Face 與 Kaggle。
google.analysis_en: This is a productized open embedding release, not a new frontier chatbot. The practical change is private cross-modal search on phones and laptops; whether it beats larger specialist embedders outside Google’s own tables is still open.
google.analysis_zh: 這是產品化的開放嵌入模型，不是新的前沿聊天模型。實質改變是手機與筆電上的私密跨模態搜尋；它是否在 Google 自測表之外勝過更大的專用嵌入模型，仍待第三方驗證。
google.quote: Today, we’re launching EmbeddingGemma 2, expanding beyond text to unify code, images, video, and audio in a shared embedding space.
google.quote_zh: 今天我們推出 EmbeddingGemma 2，從文字擴展到把程式碼、影像、影片與音訊統一到同一個嵌入空間。

google.title_en: Google ships Nano Banana 2.1 image model update
google.title_zh: Google 推出 Nano Banana 2.1 圖像模型更新
google.summary_en: Google’s Gemini API docs list Gemini Nano Banana 2.1 (`gemini-nano-banana-2.1`) as the latest high-efficiency image generation and editing model, an update to Nano Banana 2. Google cites better realism at 1K, 2K, and 4K, fixed tiling on extreme aspect ratios, stronger text and infographic layout, fusion of up to 14 reference images, search grounding, and configurable thinking. Reporting says it is rolling out to the Gemini app, AI Mode, AI Studio, Flow, and related Google products.
google.summary_zh: Google Gemini API 文件列出 Gemini Nano Banana 2.1（`gemini-nano-banana-2.1`），作為 Nano Banana 2 的高效圖像生成與編輯更新。Google 稱 1K、2K、4K 更寫實，極端長寬比的拼接瑕疵已修，文字與資訊圖排版更準，最多融合 14 張參考圖，並支援搜尋落地與可調思考等級。報導稱它正推向 Gemini app、AI Mode、AI Studio、Flow 等產品。
google.analysis_en: This is a versioned image-model update, not a new frontier LLM. The user-facing change is consistency and wide-frame quality at Flash-class cost; independent quality comparisons were not in the docs page.
google.analysis_zh: 這是圖像模型的版本更新，不是新的前沿語言模型。使用者端的變化是 Flash 級成本下的一致性與寬幅畫質；文件頁沒有獨立品質對照。
google.quote: Gemini Nano Banana 2.1 is the latest high-efficiency image generation and conversational editing model.
google.quote_zh: Gemini Nano Banana 2.1 是最新的高效圖像生成與對話式編輯模型。

google.title_en: Google details Earth AI outbreak forecasts with health partners
google.title_zh: Google 說明 Earth AI 與衛生夥伴的疫情預報
google.summary_en: Google Research and Google Health published field results for Google Earth AI, pairing AlphaEarth Foundations, the Population Dynamics Foundation Model, and a prototype Geospatial Reasoning agent with partner health data. With WHO AFRO and other health partners, Google describes agent-assisted targeting during an active outbreak rather than a generally available product.
google.summary_zh: Google Research 與 Google Health 公布 Google Earth AI 的現場結果，把 AlphaEarth Foundations、人口動態基礎模型與原型地理空間推理代理，和夥伴的衛生資料搭配。與 WHO AFRO 等衛生夥伴合作時，Google 描述的是疫情進行中的代理輔助標定，而不是一般可取得的產品。
google.analysis_en: The shift is from maps to agent-assisted targeting in an active outbreak, but the figures come from partner prototypes rather than a generally available product. Lead time and false-alarm rates still need independent replication.
google.analysis_zh: 變化是從地圖走到疫情中的代理輔助標定，但數字來自夥伴原型，不是一般公開產品。前置時間與誤報率仍需獨立複現。
google.quote: We're helping public health leaders overcome reporting lags, forecast disease outbreaks, and deliver care to vulnerable communities around the world by combining local health data with advanced geospatial models.
google.quote_zh: 我們協助公衛主管克服通報延遲、預報疾病爆發，並把在地衛生資料與進階地理空間模型結合，把照護送到脆弱社區。

google.title_en: Google Flow Music Spaces can export as DAW plugins
google.title_zh: Google Flow Music 的 Space 可匯出成 DAW 外掛
google.summary_en: Google Labs said producers can now export custom Spaces from Google Flow Music as VST3 or AU plugins and run them inside a digital audio workstation. Spaces are instruments or effects described in natural language, without coding. Google positioned the export as a bridge from the Labs experiment into existing studio software.
google.summary_zh: Google Labs 表示，製作人現在可把 Google Flow Music 的自訂 Space 匯出成 VST3 或 AU 外掛，放進數位音訊工作站使用。Space 是用自然語言描述的樂器或效果，不必寫程式。Google 把這次匯出定位成從 Labs 實驗接到現有錄音軟體的橋。
google.analysis_en: This is a creator-tool bridge from a Labs experiment into existing studio software, not a model launch. Adoption depends on whether exported plugins hold up in professional sessions.
google.analysis_zh: 這是從 Labs 實驗接到現有錄音軟體的創作者工具橋，不是模型發布。採用取決於匯出的外掛能否撐住專業工作階段。
google.quote: Producers can now export their custom Spaces as VST3/AU plugins, to run inside their Digital Audio Workstations (DAWs).
google.quote_zh: 製作人現在可以把自訂 Spaces 匯出成 VST3/AU 外掛，在數位音訊工作站裡執行。

meta.title_en: Meta and Sierra publish a Personal Agent Protocol
meta.title_zh: Meta 與 Sierra 提出個人代理協定
meta.summary_en: Sierra said it and Meta are developing Personal Agent Protocol, an open standard for how personal AI agents authenticate and act with businesses via websites, APIs, or a company-owned agent. Named partners include Genesys, Instinct, Rocket, Shopify, Stripe, and Walmart. The write-up frames consumer consent and merchant controls as the core design, and does not ship a Meta product toggle.
meta.summary_zh: Sierra 表示正與 Meta 開發 Personal Agent Protocol，一套開放標準，規範個人 AI 代理如何透過網站、API 或企業自有代理向商家驗證身分並執行操作。具名夥伴包括 Genesys、Instinct、Rocket、Shopify、Stripe 與 Walmart。文章把消費者同意與商家控制當成核心設計，並未推出 Meta 產品開關。
meta.analysis_en: The story is a standards bid around agentic commerce, not a Muse feature launch. Adoption depends on whether merchants implement it; the primary post is Sierra’s, with Meta listed as a co-developer rather than the publisher.
meta.analysis_zh: 這是代理商務的標準提案，不是 Muse 功能上線。採用與否取決於商家是否實作；主要貼文來自 Sierra，Meta 被列為共同開發者而非發布方。
meta.quote: Today we’re excited to announce Personal Agent Protocol — an open standard Meta and Sierra are developing along with industry partners.
meta.quote_zh: 今天我們宣布 Personal Agent Protocol——Meta 與 Sierra 正與產業夥伴共同開發的開放標準。

frontier_other.title_en: Mistral launches Large 4 preview, nicknamed Le Chonk
frontier_other.title_zh: Mistral 推出 Large 4 公開預覽，暱稱 Le Chonk
frontier_other.summary_en: Mistral launched a public preview of Mistral Large 4, officially nicknamed le Chonk, a natively multimodal mixture-of-experts model it describes as about 1 trillion parameters with 49 billion active. The model card lists 1.05 trillion total and 52 billion active plus a 1.6 billion vision encoder, a 1 million-token context, and preview pricing of $1.36 per million input tokens and $4.18 output. It was trained from scratch on 3,800 NVIDIA Grace Blackwell GPUs in Mistral’s European datacenters; the preview API is on Mistral Studio, and weights are planned by the end of October after partner red-teaming.
frontier_other.summary_zh: Mistral 公開預覽 Mistral Large 4，正式暱稱 le Chonk。公告稱其為原生多模態混合專家模型，約 1 兆參數、490 億啟動；模型卡則列 1.05 兆總參數、520 億啟動，另有 16 億視覺編碼器、100 萬 token 上下文，預覽價為每百萬輸入 1.36 美元、輸出 4.18 美元。模型在歐洲自有資料中心的 3,800 顆 NVIDIA Grace Blackwell GPU 上從零訓練，預覽 API 已上 Mistral Studio，權重預計 10 月底、夥伴紅隊測試後釋出。
frontier_other.analysis_en: This is the clearest European open-weight bid at frontier scale in the window, but the weights are not public yet and headline cyber scores are Mistral’s own. The practical shift is a sovereign preview endpoint now, with auditability deferred until the late-October weight drop.
frontier_other.analysis_zh: 這是窗口內最明確的歐洲開源權重前沿嘗試，但權重尚未公開，資安分數也是 Mistral 自報。實質變化是現在有主權預覽端點，可審計性要等到月底權重釋出。
frontier_other.quote: Today, we’re launching a public preview of Mistral Large 4. Unofficially ML4, very officially: le Chonk. Weights drop end of this month.
frontier_other.quote_zh: 今天我們推出 Mistral Large 4 公開預覽。非正式稱 ML4，正式暱稱是 le Chonk。權重將於本月底釋出。

brief_en: Mistral previewed Large 4 (le Chonk), a roughly 1T multimodal MoE, with weights due this month. Google shipped EmbeddingGemma 2 and Nano Banana 2.1. Anthropic widened cyber access into three tiers. OpenAI published AI math results, an Ironclad agent study, the Decisions API, and simpler API tiers.
brief_zh: Mistral預覽兆級Large 4，權重月底開放。Google釋出嵌入與繪圖更新。Anthropic擴成三級資安驗證。OpenAI公布數學成果與決策API。
